horizons.unit: NIFTY 500 trading sessions after the prediction date

sigma.input: daily simple percentage changes (close_i / close_{i-1} - 1) x 100
sigma.sessions: the 20 sessions ending at t-1; day t excluded; comparable bars only
sigma.source: volatility20, frozen in the prediction record

firstMatchWins.rule: not D, and at least one of P, E, N but not all three
not D, and at least one of P, E, N but not all three

definitions.group: sign of the day-t change; unchanged stocks are not in the pool
invalidWindow: any bar in t+1..t+h in a different comparable price segment than bar t (discontinuity); the raw unadjusted return is stored
pending until the calendar has passed t+h and the archives are ok

flags.volWindowOutlier: max |daily change| in the sigma window >= 3.5 sigma

headline.perHorizon: each horizon on its own; 1-session and 5-session results are never combined
headline.directions: gainers and losers reported side by side; no pooled headline

denominator.completedOutcomes: stock-days whose outcome status for the horizon is complete (class in confirmed, partial, failed, reversal, sideways)
denominator.uniqueStockDay: one stock on several lists on one date is one stock-day; list memberships and ranks stay in the record

definitions.meaning: A deterministic, versioned description of what a price did over 1 or 5 sessions after a classification date, measured against a volatility-scaled materiality band fixed from information available at the classification date. Confirmed is not a probability, a predictive confidence or a profitable trading signal.
